headline: Nevish Line Ignites in Fierce Clashes as Wardens Secure Callahan's Passage
war_summary: In the hours following the morning dispatch, combat has flared dramatically along the Nevish Line, where casualty lists surged by nearly twelve hundred men in two hours amid accelerating enlistments. Wardens have consolidated undisputed control across Callahan's Passage, erasing the previous neutral gap to hold all ten strongholds, though fierce fighting around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage generated over sixteen hundred fresh casualties in the same span. Across the Weathered Expanse, where Colonials retain six strongholds against one Warden garrison and two ruined sites, fighting has reignited fiercely with over eight hundred casualties logged in the latest hour alone. Along the eastern reaches of the Stlican Shelf, fresh tactical clashes near Port of Rime and Breaker Town registered new exchanges within the past two hours, holding the line at seven Colonial redoubts, one Warden base, and one devastated ruin. Meanwhile, the guns have abruptly fallen silent across Palantine Berm after its earlier reclamation, and Stonecradle remains largely subdued under Colonial possession despite lingering unrest at The Reach.
